name: UNSG
description: UNSG is a multiplayer game benchmark for urban network security games, where algorithms must allocate limited police/security resources to intercept escaping criminals in city networks. It evaluates methods for solving strategic multi-agent resource allocation and attacker interception problems in realistic security settings.
evaluation_method: Game-solving performance measured by objective value / expected utility / success in intercepting attackers under benchmarked UNSG instances.
general_score_metric: expected payoff or task-specific game value
notes: Benchmark focuses on multiplayer urban security games and is intended as a platform for developing efficient learning algorithms. Exact scoring depends on the UNSG variant and instance set.
